scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limits: No claim about mean-plus-standard-deviation route choice, empirically calibrated congestion, every learning dynamic, or global historical priority. No independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof: Explicit Bernoulli mean/variance, endpoint Wardrop inequalities, strict convexity, discriminant and exact boundary factorizations.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.theorem_scope: Homogeneous mean-plus-variance nonatomic Wardrop assignment on two parallel links, one deterministic and one two-equiprobable-scenario affine road, with a permitted deterministic-road intercept; exact rational example all nonnegative risk coefficients.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: Standalone exact SymPy symbolic and rational verifier, 1127 passing assertions; finite tests supplement an analytic proof.

title: A sharp risk-aversion bistability threshold for two stochastic parallel roads
